import tkinter as tk
from tkinter import colorchooser

class ColorBlend:
    def __init__(self):
        self.root = tk.Tk()
        self.root.title("ColorBlend")

        # Create color picker frame
        self.color_picker_frame = tk.Frame(self.root)
        self.color_picker_frame.pack()

        # Create color picker buttons
        self.color1_button = tk.Button(self.color_picker_frame, text="Color 1", command=self.pick_color1)
        self.color1_button.pack(side=tk.LEFT)

        self.color2_button = tk.Button(self.color_picker_frame, text="Color 2", command=self.pick_color2)
        self.color2_button.pack(side=tk.LEFT)

        # Create slider frame
        self.slider_frame = tk.Frame(self.root)
        self.slider_frame.pack()

        # Create opacity slider
        self.opacity_slider = tk.Scale(self.slider_frame, from_=0, to=100, orient=tk.HORIZONTAL, command=self.update_opacity)
        self.opacity_slider.set(50)
        self.opacity_slider.pack(side=tk.LEFT)

        # Create direction slider
        self.direction_slider = tk.Scale(self.slider_frame, from_=0, to=360, orient=tk.HORIZONTAL, command=self.update_direction)
        self.direction_slider.set(90)
        self.direction_slider.pack(side=tk.LEFT)

        # Create position slider
        self.position_slider = tk.Scale(self.slider_frame, from_=0, to=100, orient=tk.HORIZONTAL, command=self.update_position)
        self.position_slider.set(50)
        self.position_slider.pack(side=tk.LEFT)

        # Create save button
        self.save_button = tk.Button(self.root, text="Save", command=self.save_blend)
        self.save_button.pack()

        # Initialize color blend settings
        self.color1 = "#000000"
        self.color2 = "#FFFFFF"
        self.opacity = 50
        self.direction = 90
        self.position = 50

    def pick_color1(self):
        self.color1 = colorchooser.askcolor()[1]

    def pick_color2(self):
        self.color2 = colorchooser.askcolor()[1]

    def update_opacity(self, value):
        self.opacity = int(value)

    def update_direction(self, value):
        self.direction = int(value)

    def update_position(self, value):
        self.position = int(value)

    def save_blend(self):
        # Save color blend to file
        with open("color_blend.txt", "w") as f:
            f.write(f"Color 1: {self.color1}\n")
            f.write(f"Color 2: {self.color2}\n")
            f.write(f"Opacity: {self.opacity}%\n")
            f.write(f"Direction: {self.direction}°\n")
            f.write(f"Position: {self.position}%")

    def run(self):
        self.root.mainloop()

if __name__ == "__main__":
    app = ColorBlend()
    app.run()
```

This is a basic example and can be improved and expanded to include more features and functionality.
